messages:
maya (Finance): Heads-up — HelioMaps (acct HEL-42) hit their reserved capacity over the weekend and picked up burst charges on INV-2026-0842. Customer asked for an explanation + SLA credit. I pulled the export: https://billing.internal/redwood/exports/INV-2026-0842.csv :eyes:
kevin (AcctExec): Can you paste the invoice delta? how much are we talking about? did they actually exceed the committed GPU hours or was this token-level burst?
bilal (BillingBot): Export ready: INV-2026-0842 | reserved_commit: $12,000 | burst_charges: $2,100 | burst_window: 2026-02-14T22:00Z to 2026-02-15T10:00Z | meter_file: s3://billing/exports/1923456789_INV-2026-0842.csv
sam (Revenue): 2.1k is non-trivial. Need root cause and if usage was attributable to routing/our failover. If it's our platform forcing failover, we should consider crediting.
ara (CS): Customer says they saw higher latency in eu-west-1 around 02/14 21:45Z, traffic automatically routed to us-east-1 and fell back to a heavier model variant for a short period (legacy fallback). That combo multiplied token use per request. They sent logs — cc'ing denise.
denise (EngOps): quick summary from infra: during eu maintenance, routing policy sent 18% of traffic to us-east; traffic spike + model variant fallback caused KV cache misses and many repeated prefix tokens. Meter lines (snip):
```
line,region,model,committed_hours,burst_hours,tokens_extra,cost
1,us-east-1,redwood-3b-quant,24,6,120000,480
2,us-east-1,redwood-7b-fallback,8,4,230000,920
3,eu-west-1,redwood-7b,16,2,0,0
```
denise (EngOps): Those cost numbers are at token price $0.004/token for the extra tokens. The majority of the $2.1k is from the fallback variant (line 2).
maya (Finance): Given this looks like platform-triggered routing + fallback, I propose we offer to waive 75% of the burst charges for this window and apply an SLA credit for the degraded period. Suggestation: credit = $1,650 (75% of $2,200 rounded). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sam (Revenue): I like making the customer whole but want to limit precedent. Recommend we tie it to: (a) documented incident (b) commit to prevent same fallback by default (engineering ticket), and (c) one-off credit. If eng signs off on mitigation, approve credit.
kevin (AcctExec): Approved the one-off 75% credit under those conditions. I'll notify HelioMaps and attach mitigation plan. :thumbsup:
billing-queue-bot: Credit queued -> SUBJECT: INV-2026-0842 | CREDIT_AMT: $1650 | ACTION: manual review by billing-head. Ticket #BILL-7892
maya (Finance): Thanks all. Kevin, can you ping back when the customer accepts? I'll schedule the ledger reversal after billing-head signoff and mark this as a charge dispute in our internal tracker. Closing thread unless new info. :white_check_mark:
